questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

One should keep one’s promises.

options.text: One’s promises should be kept by one.
Promises should be kept by one.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Promises should be kept.'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **active voice.**
 
• It is an imperative sentence that **expresses advice.**
 
• The **structure** of the sentence in passive voice is : **Subject (object)+ should be +past participle of the verb.**
 
• **Promises** will be the** subject **of the sentence in the passive voice and after that 'should be' is written followed by 'kept' (past participle of keep')
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 1.**

**Correct Passive Voice:__ ***Promises should be kept.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

Her wooden almirah has been destroyed by the termites.

options.text: The termites destroyed her wooden almirah.
The termites could destroy her wooden almirah.
The termites had destroyed her wooden almirah.
The termites have destroyed her wooden almirah.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'The termites have destroyed her wooden almirah.'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in passive voice, and the sentence is in the **present perfect tense.**
 
• **In passive voice,** the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence. 
 
• The passive format **'' has/have + been + third form of the verb(V3) is used''.**
 
• So, the active format **''has/have + V3"** will be used in the conversion.
 
• On conversion, **'the termites' **will become the subject of the active form, and** 'her wooden almirah' becomes the object .**
 
• Therefore, the correct active form is **'The termites have destroyed her wooden almirah.'**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**

questions.question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

Rohan asked me if Rohit still cried.

options.text: Rohan said to me, “Did Rohit still cry?”
Rohan says to me, “Does Rohit still cry?”
Rohan said to me, “Does Rohit still cry?”
Rohan said to me, “Has Rohit still cried?”

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Rohan said to me, “Does Rohit still cry?”'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question we have to change it to Direct Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• Here, 'asked' will be changed into 'said to'. 
 
• Commas and inverted commas will be added. 
 
• The conjunction 'if' will be removed.
 
• **Simple past tense** (cried) will change into **simple present tense** (cry).
 
• Both **do** and **does **are used for the present tense. The form '**does**' is only used with third person singular subjects.
 
• In the given sentence, '**does**' will be used as the sentence is talking about a third person. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.

**Correct Direct Form:**__ *Rohan said to me, “Does Rohit still cry?”*
